title: Lenar's Additions
description: A mod that brings my ideas to life in the game (or at least the ones I manage to implement!)
body:
![Lenar's Additions 1.0.0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d45b22098108cfac970bef912f72f67502cdbea0.png)
**Lenar’s Additions is a Minecraft mod that brings new ideas directly into the game, one update at a time.** 

It adds whatever I want to see in Minecraft, from new weapons to future mechanics and features. Right now it focuses on weapons, but it will keep expanding as I come up with new ideas to turn into in-game content.

## New ressource : The **Medael** Ore

The Medael ore adds 4 new weapons, alongside with a new Shield.
Those weapons brings a new unique enchantment : The Dash.

### New set of block

A new set of decorative blocks also come with Lenar's additions, made by combining _polished diorite_ and _polished granite_.




### **How to craft the Medael Weapons**

In order to get the new weapons, you'll need to get Medael ore in caves, magic dust also found in cave and the new _Enchanting Altar_ used to make enchanted amethyst, using an _amethyst shard_ and _magic dust_.
Combine _reinforced sticks_, _medael ingots_ and _enchanted amethyst_ to get them !



## Useful tips
- I **HIGHLY** suggest to use a mod like JEI or REI to see the recipes.
- Better combat is not required but **HIGHLY** suggested.

> **Thanks for downloading, hope you enjoy !**
